<!-- Generated by ggg sync; DO NOT EDIT. Edit the declaring module's manifest. -->

174 renderers, grouped by the gallery family each one appears under.
Generated from the `runtime.ui` declarations of every installed module — the
same records the gallery renders and the coverage test compares rendered
`data-ui` markers against.

Every renderer takes exactly one options struct and embeds `ui.Attrs` in it;
see [UI foundations](/docs/ui-foundations) for the convention and
[Component usage](/docs/components) for how to read an entry.

**Engine** names the third-party runtime a component lazily loads, empty for
the ones that need none. **Alpine** names the CSP-safe controller it
registers. **Fallback** marks a component that declares what it does with no
JavaScript at all; that declaration is a promise, and the a11y suite tests it.
